name: a view of the Canton waterfront
summary: This view of the Canton waterfront shows the foreign trade settlements in the 1770s. The flags visible are, from right to left, Dutch, British, Swedish, Imperial (Holy Roman Empire) and French. The artist has made no attempt to make the scene appear exotic.
